questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Sindhu mailed the letter.

options.text: Sindhu was mailed by the letter.
The letter was mailed by the Sindhu.
The letter was mailed by Sindhu.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Sindhu mailed the letter."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the letter" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "mailed" to "was mailed" (simple past passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Sindhu."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The letter was mailed by Sindhu."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Sindhu was mailed by the letter." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement.
 
• **Option 2: **"The letter was mailed by the Sindhu." – Incorrect article usage ("the Sindhu").
 
• **Option 4: **"Letter mailed by the Sindhu." – Incomplete structure (missing "was").

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He said that he might change that format.

options.text: He told, “He may change that format”.
He said, “I may change this format”.
He said, “I will change that format”.
He says, “He might change that format”.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he might change that format.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"he might change" becomes "I may change"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match direct speech pronoun change.
 
• Verb "might" is changed to "may", reflecting the potentiality in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"that format" becomes "this format"**
 
 
• The demonstrative pronoun "that" is converted to "this" to match the immediacy of direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "He said that"
 
• Converted to: "He said," maintaining the reporting structure.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He told, “He may change that format”."

 
 
• The verb "told" is incorrectly used here; "said" should be used instead. Also, "told" typically requires an object.
 
• The pronoun “he” should switch to “I” to correctly reflect direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said, “I will change that format”."
 
 
• The verb "will change" incorrectly changes the meaning from a potential future action to a definite future action.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He says, “He might change that format”."
 
 
• The reporting verb "says" incorrectly uses the present tense instead of the past tense "said".
 
• The pronoun “he” should switch to “I” to reflect the direct speech accurately.
